# CDL Marketing

> CDL Marketing is a flooring marketing agency, part of CDL Management in Kirksville, Missouri. We own and run flooring showrooms ourselves, and we do marketing for flooring stores and flooring companies across the United States: flooring SEO, local SEO and Google Business Profiles, flooring website design, Google and Facebook ads, and AI search visibility (GEO). Marketing is month-to-month: if we don't do what we say, clients can let us go.

Contact: (660) 665-3889, caleb@cdl1.net. Founder: Caleb Foglesong.

## Services
- [Flooring SEO and local SEO](https://cdlmanagement.com/services/local-seo/): Google Business Profile, local pages, listings, reviews and technical SEO for flooring stores.
- [Flooring website design](https://cdlmanagement.com/services/websites/): fast showroom websites with clear product, installation and estimate paths.
- [Google and Facebook ads for flooring stores](https://cdlmanagement.com/services/paid-ads/): campaigns tied to the right offer, landing page and inquiry tracking.
- [AI search for flooring stores](https://cdlmanagement.com/services/ai-search/): clear store facts and answers so ChatGPT, Google AI and similar tools can find and quote a store.
- [Pricing and scope](https://cdlmanagement.com/pricing/)
